column1: # escalation_unclaimed（T-0437 升件老化探针——⑧mode=连鸣 首用）：升件行挂起>30min
# 无席领计数；阈内静默阈上连鸣（冻结必须持续发声——静默死锁家族 T-0434 同族快档）。
# 「领」判据=同票后随 裁决/完成/驳回/挂起 行（escalation_aged 同式+挂起——挂起行
# =席领了在办），或任后行 note 引证 升件#<id>（regex 尾随非数字防 #17 吞 #170
# ——票空升件行〔如半截部署〕的领票手势=先例适用同形引证径）。
# 本探针自鸣行（note 前缀 升件老化）不计——防自激（鸣行积账令计数永不落零）。
# 阈=30 minutes 票面钦定可调（改本行 interval 即调；拍周期 30min——首鸣粒度≤2拍）。
escalation_unclaimed
column4: SELECT count(*) FROM ops_event e WHERE e.event='升件' AND e.note NOT LIKE '升件老化%' AND e.ts<now()-interval '30 minutes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_event x WHERE x.ts>e.ts AND ((e.ticket<>'' AND x.ticket=e.ticket AND x.event IN ('裁决','完成','驳回','挂起')) OR x.note ~ ('升件#' || e.id::text || '([^0-9]|$)')))
column6: 升件老化 count={v}——冻结持续发声，处置落行携 升件#id 引证即停鸣（{d}）
column7: SELECT string_agg(e.id::text,',' ORDER BY e.id) FROM ops_event e WHERE e.event='升件' AND e.note NOT LIKE '升件老化%' AND e.ts<now()-interval '30 minutes' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_event x WHERE x.ts>e.ts AND ((e.ticket<>'' AND x.ticket=e.ticket AND x.event IN ('裁决','完成','驳回','挂起')) OR x.note ~ ('升件#' || e.id::text || '([^0-9]|$)')))

column1: # heartbeat_dead 口径修（T-0457——升件#3444 处置件）：死道集剔除终态票道。
# 保活面=常驻服务道 META-<svc>（META-Dev-* 逐票道除外）/o-*/席名自名道
# （ticket=seat——dm_tick 'CTO' 同构）；票道=tno（剥 META-Dev- 前缀）对
# ops_event 终态行（裁决/完成/驳回）或无近态（>7d 无事件）即剔——仅
# 「未终态且有近态」的应活未活票道入数；闭票道永缄不再积死道（248→0 实证）。
heartbeat_dead
column4: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT ticket,seat,max(last_activity) m,regexp_replace(ticket,'^META-Dev-','') tno FROM ops_headless GROUP BY ticket,seat) t WHERE m<now()-interval '7 days' AND ((ticket LIKE 'META-%' AND ticket NOT LIKE 'META-Dev-%') OR ticket LIKE 'o-%' OR ticket=seat OR (tno<>'' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_event e WHERE e.ticket=t.tno AND e.event IN ('裁决','完成','驳回')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops_event e WHERE e.ticket=t.tno AND e.ts>now()-interval '7 days')))

column1: # dispatch_aged_water（T-0463 候水老龄量表——CTO 裁定③钦定）：票内最新
# ops_event=候水行且龄>4h 计数。「候水中」账态持续=水位/额度容量不足信号，
# 走量表连鸣不走升件（候水≠豁免——持续候水超阈照样报警，换通道而已）。
# 「最新行=候水」账态口径：候水后任一后续事件（领单/拉起/裁决/完成…）
# 即脱态不计——已解候票不误鸣；幂等闸（dispatch_water.sh）保证连续候水
# 期内仅一行，行龄=连续候水时长。阈=4h 票面钦定可调（改 interval 即调）。
dispatch_aged_water
column4: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ticket) ticket,event,ts FROM ops_event WHERE ticket<>'' ORDER BY ticket,ts DESC,id DESC) t WHERE t.event='候水' AND t.ts<now()-interval '4 hours'
column6: 派单候水老龄 count={v}——水位/额度持续满>4h=容量不足信号，查并行闸/额度冷却（{d}）
column7: SELECT string_agg(ticket,',' ORDER BY ticket) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (ticket) ticket,event,ts FROM ops_event WHERE ticket<>'' ORDER BY ticket,ts DESC,id DESC) t WHERE t.event='候水' AND t.ts<now()-interval '4 hours'
